candidate_sentence_map.S1: Hepsor’s 2025 consolidated revenue declined to €35.4 million from €38.4 million in 2024, while net profit fell to €1.0 million from €2.1 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Net profit attributable to the parent’s owners was €0.4 million, compared with €0.4 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: EBITDA decreased to €3.5 million from €4.5 million, and operating profit fell to €3.4 million from €4.3 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Margins also weakened: the gross profit margin declined to 15.9% from 17.6%, the operating margin to 9.5% from 11.3%, and the net profit margin to 2.9% from 5.6%.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: The weaker annual performance primarily reflected fewer apartment handovers, at 141 compared with 194 in 2024, lower gross margins on development projects, and higher marketing expenses of €1.3 million versus €0.9 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Marketing costs increased because the Group had more and larger projects on sale, requiring more intensive sales activity.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Finance costs and personnel expenses remained broadly unchanged, while interest income increased by €0.3 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Other operating income also increased, partly because properties were reclassified from inventories to investment property and revalued.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Revenue fell to €4.5 million from €10.5 million, gross profit to €0.7 million from €2.5 million, and operating profit to €0.3 million from €2.0 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The Group recorded a net loss of €0.5 million, compared with a €1.0 million profit in the fourth quarter of 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: The quarter included €0.8 million of other operating income from the fair-value revaluation of properties reclassified to investment property, but this did not offset lower sales and margins.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Despite lower completed sales, market activity improved.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: The Group concluded primary sales agreements for 185 homes worth €36.1 million, nearly twice the 109 homes and €19.8 million recorded in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Stabilised interest rates and a positive economic outlook in Estonia and Latvia supported demand, while projects entering construction expanded supply.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The development portfolio grew to 33 active projects with approximately 196,650 square metres of sellable area.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Homes under construction increased to 428 from 192, a 223% increase, following the launch of projects in Estonia and Latvia.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: The Group strengthened its project pipeline and financing during the year.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: It added six residential projects representing approximately 700 planned apartments and 2,500 square metres of commercial space, and established a joint venture with EfTEN for the Lasnamäe development.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: In November, Hepsor raised €8.0 million through bonds carrying a 9.50% annual interest rate.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Year-end assets were €91.8 million, up 3.4%, while equity increased 23.0% to €27.1 million, partly due to a €5.8 million non-cash contribution from a non-controlling interest.
candidate_sentence_map.S22: Interest-bearing loans fell to €47.7 million from €54.7 million, although cash decreased to €3.8 million from €6.2 million and annual net cash flow was negative at €2.6 million.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1-K7 are all PRESENT with sufficient core coverage: K1 covers revenue, profit, margins, and Q4 results; K2 covers apartment handovers and their impact; K3 covers primary sales agreements and drivers; K4 covers profitability pressures; K5 covers the bond offering; K6 covers portfolio expansion; K7 covers project status. However, K8 (Toronto City Council approval), K9 (2026 project plans), and K10 (February 2026 loan agreement) are MISSING entirely. The score is 3 (Generally yes) because most HIGH-importance criteria are covered, but three specific future/development items are absent, creating a notable gap in completeness.
